intent: Increased sensor size to 0.016 m and widened sensor lateral positions to [-0.05, -0.025, 0, 0.025, 0.05] to improve line detection coverage and reduce line loss events, especially on the slalom track. Expect improved progress and completion rates without changing chassis dimensions to maintain stability.
rationale: The previous design with 5 sensors spaced narrowly (±0.04 m) and sensor size 0.012 m showed good completion and progress on oval and s-bend tracks but poor performance on the slalom track, with high line loss events (0.85) and no finishes. The integrator feedback suggests increasing sensor size to 0.016 m to improve line detection coverage and widening sensor lateral positions to [-0.05, -0.025, 0, 0.025, 0.05] to cover a wider lateral range, which has improved progress in earlier tests. We keep the same number of sensors (5) for simplicity and to maintain manageable control complexity. The chassis dimensions remain unchanged to preserve stability and off-track tolerance. We request measurements including completion, progress, line_loss_events, rms_error, and completion_time to monitor improvements in line detection and control accuracy. The intent is to enhance line detection and reduce line loss events, especially on challenging tracks like the slalom, expecting better progress and completion rates.
